definitions.explanation: A series of successive victories without any losses in between. Used in sports, games, competitions, and other contests.

examples.japanese: チームは{現在|げんざい}5{連勝|れんしょう}{中|ちゅう}だ。
examples.english: The team is currently on a 5-game winning streak.

examples.japanese: {連勝|れんしょう}が10で{止|と}まった。
{新記録|しんきろく}の20{連勝|れんしょう}を{達成|たっせい}した。
examples.english: They achieved a new record of 20 consecutive wins.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
・{連|れん} (consecutive) + {勝|しょう} (victory)

COUNTING STREAKS:
・2{連勝|れんしょう} (two consecutive wins)
・5{連勝|れんしょう} (five consecutive wins)
・10{連勝|れんしょう} (ten consecutive wins)

RELATED TERMS:
・{連敗|れんぱい} (losing streak) - antonym
・{連続|れんぞく}{勝利|しょうり} (consecutive victories - formal)
・{白星|しろぼし} (win - sumo term, marked by white circle)
・{黒星|くろぼし} (loss - sumo term, marked by black circle)

SPORTS CONTEXT:
・{プロ野球|やきゅう} (professional baseball) - season streaks
・{相撲|すもう} (sumo) - tournament streaks
・サッカー (soccer) - league streaks

COLLOCATIONS:
・{連勝|れんしょう}を{続|つづ}ける (to continue a winning streak)
・{連勝|れんしょう}が{止|と}まる (for a winning streak to stop)
・{連勝|れんしょう}を{伸|の}ばす (to extend a winning streak)
・{連勝|れんしょう}{記録|きろく} (winning streak record)
・{連勝|れんしょう}{街道|かいどう} (on a winning run)
